name: shinchantw_cbt_first_charge_timing_20260729_160845_471449
sql:
/* 首充距创角时间：只统计首充发生在所选周期内的用户。 */
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
AllFirstCharge AS (
    SELECT v."#user_id" AS user_id, v."#event_time" AS first_charge_time, v."$part_date" AS charge_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v."#user_id" ORDER BY v."#event_time") AS charge_rank
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (v.sandbox IS NULL OR v.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (v.is_freebuy IS NULL OR v.is_freebuy = FALSE)
),
TargetFirstCharge AS (
    SELECT fc.*
    FROM AllFirstCharge fc
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist ub ON fc.user_id = ub.user_id
    WHERE fc.charge_rank = 1 AND ub.user_id IS NULL
      AND fc.charge_date BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
),
UserNewRole AS (
    SELECT "#user_id" AS user_id, MIN("#event_time") AS new_role_time
    FROM ta.v_event_18
    WHERE "$part_event" = 'new_role'
    GROUP BY 1
),
TimeDiffStats AS (
    SELECT fc.user_id,
           DATE_DIFF('minute', CAST(nr.new_role_time AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(fc.first_charge_time AS TIMESTAMP)) AS diff_minutes
    FROM TargetFirstCharge fc
    INNER JOIN UserNewRole nr ON fc.user_id = nr.user_id
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN diff_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN '01_0-10min'
        WHEN diff_minutes BETWEEN 11 AND 30 THEN '02_10-30min'
        WHEN diff_minutes BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '03_30-60min'
        WHEN diff_minutes BETWEEN 61 AND 120 THEN '04_60-120min'
        WHEN diff_minutes BETWEEN 121 AND 180 THEN '05_120-180min'
        WHEN diff_minutes BETWEEN 181 AND 240 THEN '06_180-240min'
        WHEN diff_minutes > 240 THEN '07_240min以上'
        ELSE '08_异常数据(时间错乱/未关联创角)'
    END AS "首充距创角时间区间",
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS "首充人数",
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)) OVER (), 2) AS "人数占比(%)"
FROM TimeDiffStats
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
